Definition: to manipulate, i.e. seize; chiefly to capture, wield, specifically, to overlay; figuratively, to use unwarrantably
BiblicalUsage: 1) to catch, handle, lay hold, take hold of, seize, wield; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to lay hold of, seize, arrest, catch; 1a2) to grasp (in order to) wield, wield, use skilfully; 1b) (Niphal) to be seized, be arrested, be caught, be taken, captured; 1c) (Piel) to catch, grasp (with the hands)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
